text: Most people favor an indirect style of communicating. It is generally not acceptable to say directly what you think, especially if it could be taken the wrong way or be deemed offensive.

Personal space differs from place to place based on tribal and religious influences. Generally, an arm’s length or a bit less is appropriate. Personal space tends to be less between members of the same gender, good friends and family. Between good friends and family members of the same sex, it is common to touch the hands, legs, and shoulders during conversations. Sometimes men hold hands while talking and talking. This tends to be the same between two women.

Direct eye contact tends to be the norm during conversations in most urban environments. In rural and tribal settings, it is not common for girls to look boys in the eyes, and it is also rude to look the chief in the eyes.

A common saying states that the Swiss invented the watch but Africans invented time. Being on time is somewhat of a joke in has become completely normal and expected to be late to everything. T he boss or chief often arrives late as well. If planning a conference or a meeting, one can expect everyone will come an hour late. Buses usually have a schedule but it they are rarely followed.

Traditionally women are expected to stay at home, care for the children, cook and clean. H owever, things are now changing with more and more women becoming professors, business people, and ministers in the government. Machismo is still prevalent and many men that do not accept women as their equals.

A common sound is a tack-tack clicking with the tongue meaning, “oh really?” Placing both hands on the head is like saying “what a disappointment!” When gesturing or beckoning for someone to come, it's best to face your palm downwards and make a scratching motion with the fingers. Waving the index finger back and forth usually means no . Making one hand into a fist and then slapping it slapping it into with the palm of your other hand means “very much” or “ a lot ”. Sometimes the forefinger and pinky are extended and used to mime Dracula teeth, making fun of someone for having bad teeth.
Always ask permission before taking a photograph. Refrain from photographing airports, military establishments, government buildings, or military personnel in uniform.

The legal drinking age is 18 and the purchase age is 21. Penalties for possession, use, or trafficking in illegal drugs in are severe, and convicted offenders can expect long jail sentences and heavy fines.

Dress at the university level depends on the region, varying from traditional dress to normal casual western clothes. The school year sta r ts in September and ends in either May or June. There is a Christmas, Easter and summer vacation. At the university levels, grades follow the French system, which is based on 0-20, with 20 being perfect and nearly impossible to achieve. The pass/fail level is 10. Classes are generally taught using a lecture style in which the professor speaks and students take notes. Occasionally students are responsible for presenting in front of the class on assigned subjects.

Most socializing goes on in chic restaurants, at the cinema or in night clubs. Dating happens rarely in , if at all. it is generally expected that the guy who will ask the girl out. A first date might consist of going to dinner or the cinema. As a foreigner it is best to avoid going out late, especially alone, as it may not be very safe.
Since French and English and both official languages in Cameroon, speaking either or both is beneficial.
